content:
jess_marketing: Quick sync — Arcadia interview is done, they signed the NDA yesterday and ok'd a short testimonial. Need legal on the final quote and ops to confirm logo + customer story routing. Doc: https://docs.google.com/arcadia-spotlight-draft

tonY_pm: timeline? when do we need final approvals for Wednesday launch?

jess_marketing: Ideally EOD Tuesday for marketing assets. Webinar slot we're proposing is Thu 11am PT. @sam_cs can you confirm customer availability for webinar + lead routing?

sam_cs: Confirmed with customer — they can do Thu 11am PT but prefer 30-min fireside. Also they want all questions approved by them ahead of time.

mira_legal: I'll review the quote and the release language. Paste the proposed quote here plz.

jess_marketing: paste quote: "Redwood's inference platform reduced our per-request latency by 60% and cut hosting spend by ~35%," — Dr. Priya Mehta (VP of Data @ Arcadia Health)

jess_marketing: here's the exact asset links: slides + headshot + transcript: https://drive.google.com/arcadia-assets

mira_legal: quick notes: need explicit permission for the company name in marketing and for the headshot release. Also suggest changing wording from "cut hosting spend" -> "reduced hosting spend" for accuracy. I'll push redlines by 3pm.

alex_sales: For inbound lead routing: create HubSpot list "Arcadia webinar" and webhook to SDR queue; want form capture field "use_case_1" to route. @tony_pm can you confirm webhook dev owner?

tony_pm: eng-ops will own webhook. I'll ping @ops-bot for deployment once legal signs off.

ops-bot: deploy webhook job queued: job #4421. Will run after "assets-approved" label applied.

jess_marketing: thanks all — @mira_legal say when approved and I'll send final to customer. :thumbsup:

mira_legal: Approved with edits. I've uploaded redlined doc: https://docs.google.com/arcadia-spotlight-redline and added a comment for the headshot release. :white_check_mark:

sam_cs: I'll send the final questions to Arcadia and cc legal. Will also confirm speaker bio.

jess_marketing: If legal is good, can someone add the "assets-approved" label in GH repo? repo: https://github.com/redwood/marketing-campaigns/pulls/129

alex_sales: I added the HubSpot list and webhook skeleton. SDRs notified.

jess_marketing: final checklist for Tuesday EOD: legal approved ✅, assets in drive ✅, HubSpot + webhook ✅, customer confirmation of Qs ✅, webinar invite scheduled ✅. Anything missing?

tony_pm: log the launch in release-war-room channel and tag infra on Wed morning.

jess_marketing: will do. Thanks team!
